role: Druid: plants growth that stays and ages, calls beasts out of it, and buffs you and your beasts.
reflux_why: Unchanged. The plants and the beasts do the work after the cast; the price is time and place (growth is slow to pay out and does not spread on stone). Between Earth's 0.4 and Life's 1.0, nearer Earth: what Nature makes stays, like stone.
rule: Nature's growth stays in the ground and ages (sprout, grown, bloom), spreading on open ground; you and your beasts standing in your growth are In the Green - regrowing 1.5 health a second and hard to move - and any patch can be called up as a beast.
rule_why: The old rule (growth that stays, spreads and ages) was all Earth: ground that stays. The role adds Life's half: the growth is alive, it heals what stands in it, and it bears beasts. In the Green is one place-based buff that carries both parents at once: Life's regrowth and Earth's footing. It also gives the druid a reason to fight on its own ground.
band_shift: Direct hits on the low side (Thornburst 60, sweep 1.8x): the druid's damage is in growth over time and in its beasts. Costs at the bands; summons and buffs mid (10-14).

skills.name: Overgrowth
skills.summary: For 8 s you and every beast of yours within 8 m grow larger and stronger: 20% more damage, half the poise loss, and every blow you land regrows you 2 health.
skills.verb_fit: Grow is making a thing larger and stronger; here the thing is you and your pack. Parents: Life's Strengthen (the body grows, and the blows it lands feed it) and Earth's footing (half the poise loss, hard to knock down).

new_mechanics.name: overgrown
new_mechanics.definition: A buff on the player or a summon (shared buff, life.json): damage it deals x damage_mult, poise it loses x poise_loss_mult, and each hit it lands regrows heal_per_hit to the bearer (a beast heals itself; you heal you).

new_mechanics.name: in the green
new_mechanics.definition: Affinity rule, a state, never applied by a skill: while the player or a summon of theirs stands on one of the caster's growth patches it regrows 1.5 health a second (life healing order for the player), shoves on it go x0.5 as far and it loses x0.5 poise. Not stacked by overlapping patches. Shown as a leaf on the HUD.

good_modifiers.word: a long season of growth: half as long again
thriving: 30% longer, 10% stronger
the growth reaches beasts 30% further off
grown and let loose: quicker to cast, 10% harder

bad_modifiers.why: making smaller what you grow; the verbs cancel and the word should not form.
a growth that dies back: 30% shorter, and the damage half has no hit to raise. The word kills what it grows.

skills.name: Dwindling Gall
skills.summary: A gall-vine takes root in one enemy within 9 m and shrinks it for 8 s: 20 damage, it counts one weight class lighter, and its reach is cut by 30%. When it dies, the gall falls and grows a bramble patch.
skills.verb_fit: Shrink makes a thing smaller, and a plant does it. Utility: the druid's answer to a brute. Parents: Life (it feeds on a living host) and Earth (what is left is growth in the ground).

good_modifiers.word: a slow gall: half as long again
rooted from 40% further away
the gall calls your beasts: Quarry as well

bad_modifiers.why: making larger the thing you shrink; the verbs cancel.
a smite is not a shot; pierce falls back to a small damage bonus.

skills.name: Thornburst
skills.summary: Point, 9 m: after 0.35 s thorns burst up. 60 and Slowed to everything within 1.5 m, and the thorns stay as a bramble patch that spreads and thickens the longer it stands - ground you can stand in, and a beast you can call.
skills.verb_fit: Sprout is growing plants from the ground. The hit is the plants coming up; what stays is the plants. Parents: Earth (it comes up out of the floor and stays) and Life (it is alive and keeps growing).

new_mechanics.name: growth, bramble, leave_growth
new_mechanics.definition: Unchanged from the 2026-10-22 draft (heartwood and thornburst there): patches of the caster's plants, 2 m, three ages, spread every 5 s once grown, 12 per caster, no spreading on stone, burned by fire. Bramble slows and does 6 a second to enemies moving in it.

good_modifiers.word: the shoots grab: Rooted as well
a bigger burst: 20% wider and 10% harder
it comes up sooner
a wider bed of thorns

bad_modifiers.why: killing the plants the skill grows; the word contradicts itself.
a burst from the ground is not a shot; pierce falls back.

skills.name: Heartwood
skills.summary: Point, 8 m: a sapling bursts up into a trunk in 0.6 s, shoving anyone there aside for 25. For its first 6 s every enemy within 5 m turns on it instead of you. It blocks walking and shots for 30 s, toughens every second, and every 5 s spreads a bramble patch at its foot. One at a time.
skills.verb_fit: A tree sprouted from the ground. Parents: Earth (a wall that stays and takes the blows - the area tank's stone, here drawing the pack onto itself) and Life (it grows tougher every second it stands).
skills.change: Moved from Grow to Sprout (Grow now carries Overgrowth, the buff; a tree is a plant grown from the ground). It draws enemies for its first 6 s.

new_mechanics.name: decoy_radius / decoy_s
new_mechanics.definition: The decoy key of death.json's Death Mask, on any prop: for decoy_s after it rises, enemies within decoy_radius take it as their target instead of the player.

good_modifiers.word: an old tree: half as long again
a thriving trunk: 30% longer
planted deep: a slower rise, a harder shove, a longer life
a broader trunk that draws from further

bad_modifiers.why: making smaller the thing you raise; the verbs cancel.
a wilting tree lives 30% shorter; the word kills what it grows.

skills.name: Sere Ground
skills.summary: Point, 10 m: every patch of your growth within 4 m dies at once, and everything standing in one takes 30 (45 if grown, 60 in bloom). The ground is clear again.
skills.verb_fit: Wilt is killing plants and clearing ground; you give up growth and its dying is the damage. Parents: Earth (the ground cleared) and Life (a life ended pays out).
skills.numbers_note: recovery is the default cast recovery made explicit, so the ascension speed aspect has a field.

good_modifiers.word: a wider clearing
all of it at once: 20% harder
it dies of a blight that jumps to them: Blighted on everyone caught

bad_modifiers.why: growing what you are killing; the word contradicts itself.
strengthening growth as you kill it; contradicts itself.

skills.name: Greening
skills.summary: Every patch of your growth within 12 m grows one age at once and puts out a new patch. For 6 s all of it works 50% harder, and you and your beasts In the Green regrow twice as fast and hit 15% harder.
skills.verb_fit: Flourish strengthens what grows - the patches and, now, the living things standing in them. Parents: Life (the regrowth doubled) and Earth (the ground itself grows stronger).
skills.change: Role shaping: it buffs you and your beasts while you stand In the Green, not only the patches.

new_mechanics.name: green_heal_mult / green_damage_mult
new_mechanics.definition: Field-pulse keys: for duration, In the Green's regrowth is x green_heal_mult and bodies of the caster's In the Green deal x green_damage_mult.

good_modifiers.word: a long season: half as long again
the greening reaches 30% further
the ground remembers: 30% longer

bad_modifiers.why: killing what you make thrive; contradicts itself.
a sickness of growing things on the skill that makes them thrive; nobody to land on, it falls back.

skills.name: Heartrot
skills.summary: One enemy within 9 m, then two more within 5 m of each other: 40 each and Blighted for 8 s - their wooden shields and bows rot (shield half, aim slower) and Nature hits them 20% harder.
skills.verb_fit: Blight is a sickness of growing things: it rots the wood in their hands. Utility: the druid's reach into a shield line. Parents: Life (a sickness that spreads body to body) and Earth (rot, what the ground does to wood).

good_modifiers.word: it spreads to one more
the rot lasts half as long again
the rot calls the pack: Quarry on each

bad_modifiers.why: making thrive the wood you are rotting; the verbs cancel.
the shove lands, but the word says nothing about blight.

skills.name: Reaping Sweep
skills.summary: A wide scything sweep through 180 degrees: 1.8x strike damage. Each patch of your growth in the arc is cut back to a sprout and adds 15% to the blow (up to 60%), 1 essence and 3 health to you; the roots stay and regrow.
skills.verb_fit: Harvest is taking what has grown and its yield. Parents: Earth (the ground's yield, cut and left to regrow) and Life (the yield feeds your body).
skills.change: Role shaping: each patch reaped also regrows you 3 health.

new_mechanics.name: per_patch_heal
new_mechanics.definition: A harvest key: each growth patch reaped regrows the caster this much (over 2 s).

good_modifiers.word: a wider swathe
a bigger scythe: longer and harder
the cut stalks catch their legs: Rooted
a cutting stroke: 30% more poise damage

bad_modifiers.why: planting and reaping in one stroke; the verbs cancel.
pierce means nothing on a sweep.

skills.name: Scatter Seed
skills.summary: Throw five seeds over a 2.5 m spread within 9 m. Each lies hidden until an enemy steps on it (or for 6 s), then bursts: 35 and Rooted for 1 s, and a snarevine patch that stays and spreads.
skills.verb_fit: Sow is planting a thing to act later. Parents: Earth (hidden in the ground, waiting) and Life (it grows when its time comes).

good_modifiers.word: seed flung wider
seeds that wait half as long again
quick seed: they sprout on their own sooner

bad_modifiers.why: reaping seed before it has grown; the verbs cancel.
seeds that die in the ground; the word kills what it plants.

skills.name: Vine Reach
skills.summary: A vine lashes to a point within 9 m and hauls you there. Enemies within 1.5 m of where you land take 20 and are Rooted for 1 s, and a snarevine patch takes root on the spot, so you land In the Green.
skills.verb_fit: Tangle is vines binding: the vine binds to a point and pulls you to it, then binds what is there. Parents: Earth (rooted in place, the ground holds them) and Life (a living vine).
skills.change: 20 damage on landing, so the ascension power aspect has a field; the summary says you land In the Green.

good_modifiers.word: a longer vine: 40% further
a faster haul
shoots come up where you land: Slowed as well

bad_modifiers.why: the shove pushes them out of the hold the vine is meant to put on them.
held in place, on the skill that moves you; it slows the haul.

skills.name: Unwinding
skills.summary: Every enemy your vines hold within 10 m is let go at once and whipped 3 m away from you for 40 (a Crush if it hits something). Anything holding you lets go too.
skills.verb_fit: Unravel is freeing what is bound; the unwinding is the throw. Utility: the druid's way out of a crowd. Parents: Life (the vines let go) and Earth (thrown against walls and stone).
skills.numbers_note: recovery is the default cast recovery made explicit, so the ascension speed aspect has a field.

good_modifiers.word: a harder whip
flung up as well as out: Aloft
a violent unwinding

bad_modifiers.why: binding again what you release; the verbs cancel.
pulling in what you fling out; contradicts itself.

skills.name: Call the Brake
skills.summary: Point at a patch of your growth within 10 m: the thicket gives up a briar hound that runs with you for 20 s - 90 health, a bite of 12 every 0.9 s that Slows. A grown patch gives a hound a quarter stronger, a bloom patch two hounds half as strong again. The patch goes back to a sprout. Up to three hounds; with no patch in range nothing happens and nothing is spent.
skills.verb_fit: Herd gathers beasts to you, called up out of the growth, and drives them onto your quarry. Parents: Earth (the ground gives them up, as it gives up stone) and Life (they are alive: Life heals them, and they stand In the Green with you).

new_mechanics.name: needs growth
new_mechanics.definition: A summon key: the point must be on one of the caster's growth patches (checked before essence is spent). The thrall's hp and damage scale by the patch's age (age_scales); a bloom patch gives bloom_count thralls; spends_patch_age resets the patch to sprout.

new_mechanics.name: briar hound
new_mechanics.definition: A beast thrall: living, fast, fights the nearest enemy or the caster's Quarry first; its bite carries on_hit. Model is a procedural stand-in until there is a creature rig source, like the Stubble's beasts.

new_mechanics.name: quarry
new_mechanics.definition: Enemy status, 1 stack, 6 s: the caster's summons switch to it and deal x1.3 to it. The Herd rune's effect.

good_modifiers.word: the hounds stay half as long again
bigger hounds: 10% harder
a thriving pack: 30% longer
call from a patch 40% further off

bad_modifiers.why: killing the growth the beast comes from; the hounds would live 30% shorter. The word cuts its own root.
a summon is not a shot; pierce falls back to a small damage bonus.

skills.name: Unleash the Pack
skills.summary: Point at one enemy within 12 m: it becomes your Quarry (20 damage) and every beast of yours within 12 m leaps on it at once, each landing 30 poise damage. For 6 s they run wild: 40% more damage and 30% faster attacks. With no beasts out it only marks the Quarry.
skills.verb_fit: Unleash lets the bound go: the pack let off its leash. Parents: Life (beasts roused to fury) and Earth (each leap lands heavy, for poise).

new_mechanics.name: command
new_mechanics.definition: A smite key set: every summon of the caster within command_radius leaps to the target (moved by exact distance at leap_speed, stopping at walls), each landing summon_hit; then each takes summon_buff.

new_mechanics.name: unleashed
new_mechanics.definition: A buff on a summon: damage x damage_mult, attack rate x attack_rate_mult, for duration.

good_modifiers.word: a long hunt: half as long again
a frenzied pack: 20% harder
loosed on prey 40% further off
the quarry is held for them: Rooted

bad_modifiers.why: calling back the pack you loose; the verbs cancel and the word should not form.
a calm hunt is no unleashing; the reflux cut lands, the word says nothing.

effects.Grow: reach x1.2; power x1.1; cost x1.1
